_comment: Dotwork defaults (Claude Code, Claude Opus 5.5). Copy the keys you want to change into <game>/art_src/dotwork/dotwork.config.json; never edit this file for one machine. Environment overrides: COMFYUI_URL, COMFYUI_ROOT, COMFYUI_PYTHON, SPRITEKILN_ROOT, GODOT_BIN, ASEPRITE_BIN, DOTWORK_WORK.

design._comment_style: art direction for every built-in prompt: style = the art era, genre = the game type, setting = the world (empty: none assumed). Set them per game, e.g. "setting": "steampunk" or "cozy farm village" or "neon cyberpunk city"

action_map._comment: design action name -> SpriteKiln/Wan action (wan_action) or a custom motion; 'attack' defaults to a kick for unarmed NPCs

punch.motion: throws a strong straight punch forward with the leading arm, then pulls back to the fighting stance

cast.motion: thrusts the staff straight forward as if casting a spell, holds it fully extended, then lowers it

shoot.motion: raises the weapon to the shoulder and aims straight ahead, fires with a small recoil kick, then lowers it
